description: Saves the completed, signed PDF to this machine. Only works once every signature is in; an envelope that is still out, or only partially signed, has no signed document yet. Signed PDFs, uploaded files and answers are deleted 30 days after the envelope closes, so the sender should keep their own copy.

save_path.description: Full path to write the PDF to, e.g. C:\Users\me\Documents\signed.pdf

name: download_signed_document
title: Download the signed PDF
